dialogue.Introduction: Oh, hello there, @! I'm the Stylist. Mind the mannequins, they are terribly rude to strangers.$h#$b#I used to do hair for people far fancier than this valley. Now I do it for anyone who can pay in gold or a good story.$u
dialogue.Mon: Monday already, and the gossip is piling up like unwashed laundry. Did you hear the Merchant tried to haggle over a single pair of socks?
dialogue.Tue: Oh, @, that hat is lovely. Mind you, it would look even better on someone with a proper hairstyle to match.$h
dialogue.Wed: Hm. The Wednesday rush always starts late, so I have time to rearrange the hair dryers. Again.
dialogue.Thu: I finally finished the new hair pins. Shiny, and only slightly dangerous to the Guide's eyebrows.$h
dialogue.Fri: It's Friday, and the whole valley seems to need a trim before the weekend. I am not complaining. Much.
dialogue.Sat: Saturday is for the saloon, and for telling everyone exactly what I think of their haircuts. Want to come along?$h
dialogue.Sun: A quiet Sunday. I'm just sitting here, sorting ribbons by colour and pretending I'm not bored.
dialogue.Mon4: Oh, you're back! Come, sit in the good chair. I was going to tell you about the Clothier's terrible new waistcoat, but I can wait.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Your hair grows so quickly. Are you sure you're not a little bit of a wizard in disguise? I'd believe it.$l
dialogue.Wed4: I keep a small notebook of the valley's best looks. Yours is on the very first page, @, in very neat handwriting.$h
dialogue.Thu4: Between you and me, the Party Girl asked me to do her hair for her party tonight. I said yes, but only because she bought the ribbons.$h
dialogue.Fri4: Do you ever notice how the mines make everyone look so tired? I'd love to give the miners a proper blow-dry, but they'd never sit still.$s
dialogue.Sat4: I'm glad you came to the saloon. It's nice to have someone to laugh with when the Tavernkeep's jokes run out.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Sundays are my favourite, @. The valley is so calm, and I can finally brush my own hair without anybody talking to me.$h
dialogue.Mon8: I have been thinking about what I'd say if you asked me why I came down here. I think I'd say I was tired of being looked at for my face and never for my heart.$s
dialogue.Tue8: You make the quiet days feel less quiet, @. I hope you know how much that means to me.$l
dialogue.Wed8: There are days I wonder if I belong here, and then you walk in with a muddy boot and a smile, and I stop wondering.$l
dialogue.Thu8: My past is not something I like to talk about, but with you I feel I could. Maybe someday I will tell you the whole story.$s
dialogue.Fri8: When the Skeletron fell and the dungeon opened, I thought of all the people who had stood by me. You were the first one I thought of.$l
dialogue.Sat8: Please don't laugh, but I keep a little jar of the valley's wildflowers on my shelf. Every one of them came from you.$l
dialogue.Sun8: I'm so glad you're in my life, @. Even when the salon is a mess and the Clothier is shouting, I feel calm when you are near.$h
dialogue.danceRejection: Oh, a dance? With you? Not yet, @. Come back when you've earned a few more hearts, and I'll dance with you properly.$s
dialogue.Tue2: I'm not sure whether to call you a customer or a friend yet. You're welcome either way.
dialogue.Thu2: Would you like to see my new brushes? They are very good. Please don't touch them with your muddy fingers.
dialogue.Sat2: I'll be honest, @, this valley has some strange people. You seem more normal than most. That is a compliment.
dialogue.Wed6: Every time you come in, the whole salon smells of wildflowers and good intentions. It's wonderful.$h
dialogue.Fri6: Do you think I'm too picky about hair? Perhaps I am. But I think a good trim can change a whole person.$h
dialogue.Sun10: If the Harvest Fair ever gives out a prize for best-dressed farmer, I'm going to nominate you, and you can thank me by coming to every appointment.$h
dialogue.Mon10: Monday again. I looked at my schedule and the only name that makes me smile is yours, @.$l
dialogue.Wed10: Some nights I lie awake thinking about how kind you've been to everyone in this town. Thank you for that.$l
dialogue.Sat10: Would you believe it, @? I used to think I'd never trust anyone again. Now I trust you with my scissors.$h
dialogue.Tue10: When this valley is finally safe from the bosses and the blood moons, I want to take a long walk with you by the sea.$l
dialogue.Fri10: You know, you're the reason I finally unpacked my last box. I hope you'll stay a long time.$l
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer Wednesdays at the salon are so hot. I keep my hair up and my spirits high, mostly thanks to people like you.$h
dialogue.winter_Sat: Winter Saturday, and the cold air makes everyone want a warm hat. Lucky for them, I make the best ones in the valley.$h
dialogue.spring_Fri: Spring Friday brings flowers and sneezing, and I cannot stand the pollen in my salon. Still, it smells like you.$l
dialogue.fall_Mon: Fall Monday, and the leaves are everywhere. I've already swept them out twice. Come along, I'll show you my favourite scarf.$h
dialogue.spring_13: Happy spring thirteenth, @. I found a pastel ribbon that matches your eyes. Hold still, I'm tying it on.$l
dialogue.summer_28: The summer twenty-eighth is so warm. Let's sit by the river tonight, I'll bring the lemonade.$h
dialogue.fall_15: Fall fifteenth. The valley has put on its best colours. You put on yours too, @, which I approve of.$h
dialogue.winter_1: The first day of winter. Let's make it cosy, I'll put the kettle on and you can tell me everything.$h
dialogue.winter_Fri8: Winter Friday, and you've come to see me again. That is the best part of my week, I promise.$l
dialogue.fall_Sun4: A quiet Sunday in fall. Bring your appetite, I've got the good pie from the Tavernkeep.

rainy: Rain again, and not a single customer in sight. Stay inside with me, @, and I'll braid your hair while the storm passes.$h

marriage.Indoor_Day_0: Good morning, dear. Hold still, I'm pinning your collar.$l
marriage.Indoor_Day_1: I laid out your green shirt. You look better in it than I ever will.$h
marriage.Indoor_Day_2: The house is quiet today. Come sit, and I'll tell you all the valley gossip.$h
marriage.Indoor_Day_3: Did you see the Merchant's new sign? Bold choice. Ugly choice, but bold.
marriage.Indoor_Day_4: Our home smells of lavender and hairspray. Perfect.$h
marriage.Rainy_Day_0: Rain again. Come sit by the window with me, I'll brush out your tangles.$l
marriage.Rainy_Day_1: The rain sounds lovely on the roof. I'd rather be cosy here than out in it.$h
marriage.Rainy_Day_2: A rainy day is the best excuse to do nothing with you, @.$l
marriage.Rainy_Day_3: I hope the mines are dry, I don't want you coming home looking like a swamp creature.$s
marriage.Rainy_Day_4: Stay home with me, dear. The storm will pass, and our cocoa will not.$h
marriage.Indoor_Night_0: Turn down the lamp, love. I want to watch the stars through the window with you.$l
marriage.Indoor_Night_1: You're quiet tonight. Is something on your mind, or are you just tired?$s
marriage.Indoor_Night_2: Come to bed, @. The salon will still be a mess tomorrow, I promise.$h
marriage.Indoor_Night_3: I can hear the crickets. Lovely, aren't they? Nearly as lovely as you.$l
marriage.Indoor_Night_4: Goodnight, @. Sleep well, and try not to snore like the Guide.$h
marriage.Rainy_Night_0: The rain on the window makes me sleepy. Hold me a little longer, please.$l
marriage.Rainy_Night_1: Listen to that storm. I'm glad I'm not out in it, and I'm glad you're here.$h
marriage.Rainy_Night_2: Shall we light a candle and tell each other stories until the rain stops?$h
marriage.Rainy_Night_3: I always sleep better when you're breathing next to me. Don't tell anyone I said that.$l
marriage.Rainy_Night_4: Goodnight, love. The rain will be gone by morning. I'll still be here.$h
marriage.Outdoor_0: What a lovely day out here. Let's keep walking, I have an idea for your hair.$h
marriage.Outdoor_1: Look at those flowers! They'd suit my salon perfectly, don't you think?$h
marriage.Outdoor_2: Oh, there's a bird on the fence. Don't scare it, @, it's probably a rare one.$u
marriage.Outdoor_3: The fresh air is good for me. Better than the Tavernkeep's hay-scented saloon, anyway.$h
marriage.Outdoor_4: Take my hand, dear. The path is muddy and I refuse to get my boots dirty alone.$l
marriage.Good_0: You make me so happy, @. I hope you know that.$h
marriage.Good_1: Oh, I just love how you smile when you come in from the fields.$l
marriage.Good_2: Everything is going so well, isn't it? I'm so glad I came to this valley.$h
marriage.Good_3: Did you finish the crops today? You're such a hard worker. I'm proud of you.$h
marriage.Good_4: Look at us, a proper home now. Who would've thought?$h
marriage.Good_5: I could stay like this all day, honestly. Don't let me forget the shop.$l
marriage.Good_6: You always know how to cheer me up. Even the Clothier looked impressed.$h
marriage.Good_7: Thank you for putting up with my fussing, dear. You're the best.$l
marriage.Good_8: I just finished a new hat design. You'll be the first to see it, I promise.$h
marriage.Good_9: I love you, @. There, I've said it, and I'm not taking it back.$l
marriage.Neutral_0: Mm, good morning. The kettle is on, if you want some.
marriage.Neutral_1: The salon bills came in again. Don't look at me like that, it's not your fault.
marriage.Neutral_2: I'm a bit tired today. Can we just sit quietly for a while?
marriage.Neutral_3: Please mind the hairpins on the floor. I stepped on three this morning.$a
marriage.Neutral_4: Have you seen my good scissors? I'm sure I left them somewhere.
marriage.Neutral_5: The valley is busy again. I'm just happy to have a quiet corner to sit in.
marriage.Neutral_6: I had a dull day at the shop, but I suppose everyone has them.
marriage.Neutral_7: Let's not talk about the Merchant's prices, I'll only get cross.$a
marriage.Neutral_8: Hm. The fair is coming, and I still need a dress. Don't say anything.
marriage.Neutral_9: I'm fine, @. Just thinking about everything that needs doing this week.
marriage.Bad_0: Must you track mud through the front room? Honestly.$a
marriage.Bad_1: I asked you to fix the shelf last week, and it's still wobbling. Hmph.$a
marriage.Bad_2: Please, not right now. I've had a horrible day with a customer.$s
marriage.Bad_3: You didn't wipe your boots, did you? Look at the rug!$a
marriage.Bad_4: I'm not angry, I'm just disappointed. There's a difference.$s
marriage.Bad_5: The dishes are still in the sink. We talked about this, @.$a
marriage.Bad_6: Don't start with me. I'm not in the mood for jokes.$a
marriage.Bad_7: I'll go and sit in the salon for a while. Call me when you've tidied up.$a
marriage.Bad_8: I know you didn't mean it, but it still stung a little. Please be careful.$s
marriage.Bad_9: We'll talk about it later. I need some air.$a
marriage.OneKid_0: Look at %kid1, asleep already. Shh, don't wake them up or you'll be doing the bedtime story.$l
marriage.OneKid_1: %kid1 drew me a picture of a hairbrush. It's terrible, and I've hung it in the salon.$h
marriage.OneKid_2: Our little one has your nose, @. Poor thing. We'll have to pray for the hair.$h
marriage.OneKid_3: I love watching %kid1 play in the garden. We made something wonderful, didn't we?$l
marriage.TwoKids_0: Our two little ones are running wild again. %kid1 and %kid2 are going to be the death of me.$h
marriage.TwoKids_1: %kid2 wants to be a stylist like me. I'm terrified and delighted at the same time.$h
marriage.TwoKids_2: Hush, %kid1, %kid2, the sun is up and you need your breakfast. Don't argue with your mother.$a
marriage.TwoKids_3: I can't believe we have two of you now. My salon is going to be full of small hands.$l
marriage.NoBed_0: The bed is still made. Did you sleep in the chair again, @?$s
marriage.NoBed_1: Come upstairs, you'll get a crick in your neck. The couch is for guests.$a
marriage.NoBed_2: I left the blanket out for you. I thought you might fall asleep on the floor again.$h
marriage.NoBed_3: Your side of the bed is cold, love. Hurry up and come home to me.$l
marriage.patio_Haley: Lovely morning on the patio. Let's have our tea out here and pretend the valley is quiet.$h
marriage.spouseRoom_Haley: I'm just tidying the spare room. It needs a proper mirror, don't you think?$h
marriage.funLeave_Haley: I'm off to the salon now, dear. Don't forget your lunch, and try not to get mud on it.$h
marriage.funReturn_Haley: I'm back! Tell me everything you did while I was gone, and don't leave anything out.$h
marriage.Outdoor_Haley: Out here with you is my favourite place in the valley, dear. Let's stay a while.$l
marriage.spring_Haley: Spring has come, and the flowers are blooming. Let's pick some for the house.$h
marriage.summer_Haley: It's summer, and I am melting in this dress. Take me to the river, @, please.$h
marriage.fall_Haley: The leaves are turning, and I'm finally wearing my favourite scarf. Do you like it?$h
marriage.winter_Haley: Winter is here, and we've got the fire going. Come curl up with me in front of it.$l

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is finally gone. I never liked the way it stared through my shop window, not one bit.$a
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds and the Brain of Cthulhu are both gone. Dreadful things, those. My salon floor is finally clean.$h
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is defeated and the dungeon is open, and the Old Man is free. I hope he has better taste in hats than the last tailor I knew.$u
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is gone. My hair smelled of honey for a week, and I am not sorry about that.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh fell and things have only got worse. The Hallow is spreading, and its crystals clash with my pastel curtains.$s
situations.mechs: One of the mechanical bosses was destroyed. Thank goodness. That screeching gave me a headache all morning.$a
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated and the jungle temple is open. I have been dreaming of a jungle-themed haircut ever since.$u
situations.golem: The Golem is destroyed. Nobody asked me to dust off the statues, but I suppose someone had to.$a
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is defeated and the celestial pillars have appeared. Terribly dramatic, but the sky looks gorgeous.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is gone. The sky has stopped flickering, and my hand mirror is no longer cracked.$h
situations.goblins: The goblins were repelled. Their whole army marched right past my salon, and not one of them asked for a trim.$s
situations.pirates: The pirates were sent packing. The Pirate spent the whole fight shouting about his parrot. Now I have a window to clean.$a
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is repelled. The cold came right through my salon door. Do you know what frost does to a perm?$a
situations.martians: The Martians have been repelled. Their ship was dreadful, all that green light, and it ruined my good lamp.$a
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. I did not sleep a wink and my complexion shows it, @.$s
situations.eclipse: The eclipse last night was the most dramatic lighting I have ever seen. Terrible for my eyes, perfect for a portrait!$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today. I'll go, but only long enough to be seen in my best hairdo.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival! I'm entering the egg hunt in a pastel bonnet, and I expect to win, @.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance is tonight. Save me a dance, and mind you don't step on my hemline.$l
festivals.summer11: I brought my fruit salad for the community soup. Don't ask me how many petals went into it.$h
festivals.summer28: The jellies are glowing like a jewellery display. Keep still and let me look at you in the moonlight, @.$l
festivals.fall16: The Fair! I have a ribbon for best-dressed scarecrow, and I am not sharing it with anyone.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve. Whoever designed this maze has terrible taste in costumes, and I told them so.$a
festivals.winter8: Ice fishing, snow sculptures, and I'm still the best-dressed person here, @. Bundle up!$h
festivals.winter25: Secret gift exchange! I wrapped the most beautiful thing I could find. Don't you dare peek.$l
festivals.spring13_spouse: Our first Egg Festival as a married couple, @. I picked matching bonnets for us. Don't argue.$l
festivals.spring24_spouse: Dance with me at the Flower Dance, dear. I don't care who is watching.$l
festivals.summer11_spouse: We made the community soup together this year. It tastes like home, and I'm not sorry for bragging.$h
festivals.summer28_spouse: Let's watch the jellies from the sand, just the two of us. I'll hold your hand the whole time.$l
festivals.fall16_spouse: Hold my ribbon while I judge the scarecrows, love. Hush, I'm not cheating, I have eyes.$h
festivals.fall27_spouse: Stay close in that maze, dear. I'd rather not be lost in it without you.$s
festivals.winter8_spouse: Your cheeks are red from the cold. Come here and let me fix your scarf.$l
festivals.winter25_spouse: Our gift exchange is the best one in town, @. I'm keeping the wrapping paper, too.$h

loved.text: Oh, @! Now that is a proper find. This is exactly what I would have picked out for myself!$h

liked.text: Lovely, @. Something to brighten up the back room of the salon.$h

neutral.text: Hm. Thanks, @. I suppose I can find a use for it.

disliked.text: Ugh, @. This is hardly my style. I'd rather not be seen holding it.$a

hated.text: Excuse me? Get that out of my salon this instant!$a

help: Help! Someone rescue my hair from this monster!
Get it away from me! Someone, anyone, help!
Hands off my hairdo! Somebody call the guard!
thanks: Oh, @, you saved me! My hair is a wreck, but I am alive.$h
Thank you, @. I owe you a trim, and no arguing about it.$l
battle: Stay back! I have... a very sharp hairpin!
Take that! Ugh, it got my good ribbon!
I will not die with my hair in this state!
courage.hurt: Look at my hairdo! Bruised, dusty and wobbling. I am resting at home with a cold cloth.$a

danger.boss: A giant monster is loose and my salon is right in its path. I am barricading the door with mannequins.$a
danger.invasion: An army is marching past my salon. I have locked every window and I am not coming out.$s
danger.pumpkinMoon: Pumpkins with terrible faces are everywhere. Their carving is dreadful and it frightens me.$a
danger.frostMoon: The frost is ruining my perms and the frozen soldiers are coming. I am wrapped in three scarves.$s
danger.eclipse: The sky has gone black! I cannot see my reflection at all, and that is simply terrifying.$s
danger.bloodMoon: The moon has gone red and I look terrible in red. I am hiding under the salon counter.$a

events.after: If you're going to stand around my salon, at least look at something useful.

steps.say: Oh! @, come in. Mind the mannequins, they are terribly rude to strangers.$h

steps.question: What brings you into my salon?

answers.text: Your hair looks wonderful, and I wanted to say so.
answers.reply: Well, obviously. Thank you, I did it myself.$h

answers.text: You could use a trim, honestly.
answers.reply: A trim from me? How dare you. Hmph.$a

steps.say: Here. Take this. A good stylist knows that one small accessory makes the whole outfit.$h
Now shoo, I have a dress to finish for the Stardew Valley Fair.$s

events.after: Keep walking, @. People will think I'm a gossip if you keep standing there.

steps.say: @! Fancy meeting you out here. I'm not shopping, I'm people watching.$h
Do you know the Clothier has been trying to copy my hat for months? Ridiculous.$a

steps.question: Want to see what I'm really working on?

answers.reply: Hm. The sketches are for my own eyes, but you may look.$h

steps.say: Honestly, I like having someone to show my sketches to. Thank you for asking.$l

events.after: The Tavernkeep's beer is strong, @. Don't let it go to your head.

steps.say: Look at the state of this place. Hay on the floor, and yet it's the only place I feel at home.$s
Another round? Fine. Don't break my glasses.$s

steps.question: Why do you come here so often?

answers.reply: Well, I suppose I'm getting used to it too.$l
Ha. Be careful, the beer is strong and my hair is not.$h

steps.say: Between us, the saloon is the only place in the valley where nobody asks me to fix their hair. It is the best.$h
Here, have a drink with me. Just one. Then I'll tell you a secret.$h

events.after: I'm glad you stayed a little longer, @. The tea is still warm.

steps.say: @, you're still awake? I was just thinking about you while I trimmed a wig.$l
Some days I wonder whether I'll ever stop feeling like the new girl in town. Then you walk in and it stops mattering.$s

steps.question: Do you ever feel out of place here?

answers.reply: Then we are in the same boat. I'm glad I'm not alone in it.$s
Lucky you. Some of us are still finding our hats.$h

steps.say: The Clothier says I'm too sentimental. He is probably right, but I'll keep my sentiment anyway.$h
Stay a little longer? I'll make us proper tea, not that swamp water the Guide drinks.$l

events.after: The stars will keep, @, but I might not. Come back and see me tomorrow.

steps.say: I didn't expect to see you here, @. I came to look at the stars. Most people never do.$l
Do you know how many people have asked me to do their hair this year? Not one of them ever asked to just sit and watch the sea with me.$s

steps.question: Would you like to sit with me a while?

answers.reply: Then sit. Right there. Don't say a word, the waves are doing the talking.$l
Oh. That's alright. I suppose the stars will keep.$s

steps.say: You know, most people look at the stars. You look at me, and I think that is better.$l
Thank you for coming, @. I mean it, and I am not one for saying that sort of thing.$h

events.after: You have me all to yourself now, love. Don't you dare waste it on the Merchant.

steps.say: @, you're home early. I was just setting out the good tea set for us.$l
The dungeon made me hard. You somehow made me soft again, and I think I like it.$l
Our little farmhouse, our little salon corner, and a proper place to hang my hats. I think I'm finally home.$h
Now come here and let me fix that terrible cowlick. The Harvest Fair is tomorrow, and I will not have my spouse looking untidy.$h
